templates.title: Narrate a short script (draft voiceover)
templates.description: Type up to 1024 characters of plain words. Without a voice the WAV is a synthetic English (United States) draft voice at 22050 Hz mono, ready for SoX conform. Listen to it and read the words before you rely on it: it is not a human recording and no pronunciation or accessibility is certified.

templates.title: Narrate a UTF-8 text file
templates.description: Choose an absolute UTF-8 .txt file (or a text artifact from an earlier step) of at most 1024 characters and 8 KiB, with line feeds only and no markup or phoneme codes. The text is captured before synthesis.

templates.title: Narrate in French, Spanish or British English (draft)
templates.description: Choose en-gb, fr-fr or es as the voice and write the script in that language: the voice speaks the words as written, it does not translate or check the language. The WAV is a synthetic 22050 Hz mono draft; listen to it and read the words before you rely on it, since the accent and pronunciation are not certified.
